sounds.description: Basic attack with a sword or other edged one-hand weapon (hero and humanoid enemies; enemies play it quieter).
Basic attack with a dagger; also the bite or claw of small beasts (non-humanoid enemies).

CAST sound (plays as the skill starts) of the physical skills: Aegis Knight: Shield Slam, Shield Throw, Shield Shove; Shadowblade: Star Fan, Grappling Hook, Dance of Blades; Iron Monk: Palm Strike, Flying Kick, Tiger Stance, Crane Stance, Hundred Fists, Rising Dragon, Whirlwind Kick. Basic attack with a greatsword, axe or scythe, or any heavy blow. Also the cleave and dash effects, and the CAST sound of every physical skill.
Basic attack with a hammer, club, staff, cannon or bare fists; the swipe of dragons, wyverns and big beasts.
Ranged basic attack with a gun, crossbow or other non-bow ranged weapon.
Ranged basic attack with a bow or sling.
Basic attack of a magic-style attacker (staff bolts, caster enemies).
The hero lands an edged blow (sword, axe). Plays UNDER every skill impact too, layered with the element sound.
The hero lands a blunt blow (hammer, club, fists, staff). Also the training dummy being knocked, and a weak forge strike at the smith. Plays under skill impacts of blunt-weapon heroes.
The hero lands a piercing blow (arrows, bolts, spears, daggers). Plays under the impact of piercing skills.

IMPACT sound (plays when the skill hits, layered over the weapon hit sound: hit, hitBlunt, hitPierce or crit) of the physical/command skills: Aegis Knight: Shield Slam, Shield Throw, Taunting Cry, Shield Shove; Shadowblade: Star Fan, Grappling Hook, Dance of Blades; Grand Sovereign: Royal Guard, Command Focus, Call Archers, Royal Rally, Banner of Victory, Royal Decree, Army of the Realm, Summon Champion; Iron Monk: Palm Strike, Flying Kick, Tiger Stance, Crane Stance, Hundred Fists, Rising Dragon, Whirlwind Kick. A heavy blow lands. Also the IMPACT sound of every physical skill and every command skill, and a strong forge strike at the smith.
A critical hit by the hero (replaces the normal hit sound, under any skill impact).
An attack is blocked; also the anvil clang when an item is upgraded on the equipment page.
An attack misses or is dodged.
The hero takes damage.
A non-skill fire hit (a burning weapon, fire damage type), quieter layer; also dragon breath.
A non-skill frost hit; also icicle and geyser bursts.
A beam effect (boss and skill beams), and beam damage.
A generic burst or explosion effect (grenades, bombs, any burst without its own sound).
Blink and rewind effects (teleports, time rewinds).
Something is summoned or deployed (pets, turrets, minions).
A heal effect; also drinking from a healing spring in a level.
A shield, bastion or buff goes up; also the fatal-save that keeps the hero alive.
The Aether-Tech overheats (heat bar full).
A boss enters a new phase; also roar effects.
An enemy starts winding up a special move (the warning before it lands).
An enemy group wakes up and notices the hero; a colosseum wave starts; the world map raises an alarm.
A boss wakes up (its entrance, with slow motion and the boss banner).
An ordinary enemy dies.
A boss dies, the hero falls, or an escorted caravan is lost.
Gold is gained: coins dropped in a fight, a sale, a reward from a quest, contract or minigame; also an item upgrade.
A common item drops, or an item is received in a dialogue.
A rare (tier 3) item drops.
An epic (tier 4 to 5) item drops.
A legendary or mythic (tier 6+) item drops.
A chest opens (in a level, after a victory, on the world map, at a trader); also the training dummy breaking apart.
The hero levels up; also a quest or errand completed, captives freed from a cage, a caravan arriving, and a forge success.
A potion is drunk, or bought from the alchemist or healer.
The colosseum crowd cheers when a wave falls.
The colosseum crowd roars (with a horn call) when a milestone wave is reached and a mythic prize appears.
Anything refused: not enough gold, requirements not met, a locked cage or chest, a busy ore vein, a wrong plate in a puzzle, a lost minigame.
Every button press, tab, select and list tap in the menus and HUD.
A window or screen opens; a chest starts opening; an errand is taken.
A window or screen closes; an item is taken off.
An item or skill is equipped; ore, herbs or a cage key picked up in a level; a small potion pickup.
Buying at a trader; taking a contract; a reward claimed on the results screen.
A skill learned at a trainer, a treatment at the healer, a lore scroll found, a puzzle solved, a minigame won.
An attribute point spent; a goal ticked; places revealed on the world map; a pressure plate stepped on.
A choice made: a dialogue answer, the class pick, a character choice.
Selecting or travelling to a place on the world map.
